# #243 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m243_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m243_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m243_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m243_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 243 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m243_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m243_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m243_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m243_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m243_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_after_hours_reply_243
				has_variable = zg361_we_m243_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m243_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m243_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m243_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m243_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m243_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m243_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m243_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_object_after_hours_message
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_resource_capacity
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_resource_on_call
						}
					var:zg361_we_m243_object_type_code = 243
					var:zg361_we_m243_consumer_contract = 243
					var:zg361_we_m243_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m243_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m243_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m243_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m243_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m243_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m243_object_case = var:zg361_we_m243_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m243_object_state = var:zg361_we_m243_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m243_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_type_code = 243
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_consumer_contract = 243
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m243_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m243_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m243_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m243_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m243_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m243_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m243_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m243_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m243_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m243_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m243_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m243_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m243_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m243_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m243_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m243_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m243_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m243_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m243_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m243_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m243_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m243_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m243_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_after_hours_reply_243 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m243_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m243_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_consumer_record_after_hours_reply_243 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m243_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #243 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.

	if = {

# #244 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m244_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m244_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m244_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m244_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 244 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m244_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m244_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m244_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m244_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m244_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_voluntary_effort_244
				has_variable = zg361_we_m244_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m244_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m244_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m244_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m244_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m244_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m244_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m244_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_object_voluntary_effort_request
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_resource_capacity
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_resource_gold
						}
					var:zg361_we_m244_object_type_code = 244
					var:zg361_we_m244_consumer_contract = 244
					var:zg361_we_m244_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m244_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m244_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m244_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m244_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m244_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m244_object_case = var:zg361_we_m244_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m244_object_state = var:zg361_we_m244_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m244_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_type_code = 244
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_consumer_contract = 244
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m244_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m244_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m244_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m244_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m244_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m244_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m244_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m244_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m244_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m244_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m244_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m244_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m244_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m244_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m244_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m244_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m244_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m244_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m244_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m244_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m244_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m244_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m244_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_voluntary_effort_244 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m244_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m244_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_consumer_record_voluntary_effort_244 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m244_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #244 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.
zg361_we_m244_route_a_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	remove_variable = zg361_we_last_red_code

	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 2
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 2
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 2
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m244_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 2
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_total
					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
					has_variable = zg361_we_hours_available
					has_variable = zg361_we_gold_available
				}
				var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
				var:zg361_we_hours_available >= 5
				var:zg361_we_gold_available >= 10
				var:zg361_case_ab_owner = { gold >= 10 }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {

# #245 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m245_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m245_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m245_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m245_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m245_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 245 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m245_write_owner

				}

			var:zg361_we_m245_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject

					var:zg361_we_m245_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m245_write_state
					}

			}

		}

		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_overtime_245 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m245_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m245_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_consumer_record_overtime_245 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m245_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m245_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m245_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 2
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m245_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m245_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m245_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m245_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m245_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m245_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 2
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2459 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # route collision typed RED
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}

# #246 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m246_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m246_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m246_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m246_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 246 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m246_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m246_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m246_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m246_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m246_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_settle_overtime_246
				has_variable = zg361_we_m246_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m246_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m246_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m246_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m246_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m246_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m246_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m246_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_object_overtime_settlement
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_resource_overtime
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_resource_gold
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_resource_leave
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_resource_target
						}
					var:zg361_we_m246_object_type_code = 246
					var:zg361_we_m246_consumer_contract = 246
					var:zg361_we_m246_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m246_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m246_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m246_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m246_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m246_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m246_object_case = var:zg361_we_m246_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m246_object_state = var:zg361_we_m246_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m246_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_type_code = 246
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_consumer_contract = 246
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m246_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m246_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m246_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m246_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m246_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m246_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m246_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m246_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m246_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m246_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m246_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m246_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m246_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m246_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m246_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m246_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m246_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m246_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m246_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m246_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m246_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m246_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m246_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_settle_overtime_246 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m246_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m246_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_consumer_settle_overtime_246 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #246 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.
zg361_we_m246_route_a_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	remove_variable = zg361_we_last_red_code

	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active

		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {

			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject

			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m246_compensation_route value = 1 }

# #247 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m247_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m247_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m247_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m247_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 247 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m247_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m247_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m247_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m247_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m247_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_open_sprint_247
				has_variable = zg361_we_m247_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m247_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m247_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m247_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m247_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m247_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m247_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m247_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_sprint_order
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_resource_capacity
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_resource_sprint
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_object_due_cycle
						}
					var:zg361_we_m247_object_type_code = 247
					var:zg361_we_m247_consumer_contract = 247
					var:zg361_we_m247_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m247_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m247_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m247_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m247_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m247_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m247_object_case = var:zg361_we_m247_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m247_object_state = var:zg361_we_m247_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m247_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_type_code = 247
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_consumer_contract = 247
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m247_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m247_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m247_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m247_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m247_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m247_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m247_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m247_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m247_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m247_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m247_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m247_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m247_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m247_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m247_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m247_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m247_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m247_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m247_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m247_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m247_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m247_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m247_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_open_sprint_247 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m247_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m247_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_consumer_open_sprint_247 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m247_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

					var:zg361_we_m248_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m248_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m248_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m248_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m248_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m248_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m248_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m248_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m248_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m248_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m248_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m248_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m248_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m248_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m248_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m248_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m248_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m248_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m248_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m248_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m248_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m248_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m248_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m248_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m248_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m248_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m248_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m248_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_understaffing_248 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m248_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m248_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_consumer_record_understaffing_248 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m248_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #249 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m249_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m249_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m249_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m249_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 249 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m249_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m249_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m249_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m249_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m249_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_meeting_249
				has_variable = zg361_we_m249_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m249_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m249_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m249_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m249_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m249_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m249_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m249_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_object_meeting
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_resource_capacity
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_resource_meeting
						}
					var:zg361_we_m249_object_type_code = 249
					var:zg361_we_m249_consumer_contract = 249
					var:zg361_we_m249_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m249_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m249_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m249_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m249_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m249_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m249_object_case = var:zg361_we_m249_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m249_object_state = var:zg361_we_m249_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m249_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_type_code = 249
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_consumer_contract = 249
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m249_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m249_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m249_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m249_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m249_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m249_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m249_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m249_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m249_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m249_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m249_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m249_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m249_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m249_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m249_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m249_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m249_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m249_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m249_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m249_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m249_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m249_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m249_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_meeting_249 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m249_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m249_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_consumer_record_meeting_249 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m249_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}

					var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total

		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2493 }

	}
	else_if = {

				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject

				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

# #250 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m250_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m250_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m250_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m250_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 250 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m250_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m250_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m250_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m250_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m250_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_meeting_contribution_250
				has_variable = zg361_we_m250_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m250_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m250_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m250_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m250_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m250_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m250_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m250_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_object_meeting_contribution
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_resource_meeting
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_resource_evidence
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_resource_credit
						}
					var:zg361_we_m250_object_type_code = 250
					var:zg361_we_m250_consumer_contract = 250
					var:zg361_we_m250_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m250_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m250_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m250_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m250_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m250_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m250_object_case = var:zg361_we_m250_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m250_object_state = var:zg361_we_m250_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m250_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_type_code = 250
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_consumer_contract = 250
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m250_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m250_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m250_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m250_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m250_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m250_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m250_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m250_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m250_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m250_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m250_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m250_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m250_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m250_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m250_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m250_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m250_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m250_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m250_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m250_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m250_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m250_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m250_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_meeting_contribution_250 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m250_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m250_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_consumer_record_meeting_contribution_250 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #250 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.
zg361_we_m250_route_a_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	remove_variable = zg361_we_last_red_code

	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m250_receipt_state

			CHOICE = 1

			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_write_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m250_write_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }

# #251 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m251_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m251_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m251_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m251_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m251_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 251 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_meeting_refusal_251
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m251_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m251_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m251_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_meeting_refusal
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m251_consumer_contract

# #252 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m252_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m252_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m252_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m252_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 252 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m252_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m252_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m252_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m252_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m252_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_normalize_leave_252
				has_variable = zg361_we_m252_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m252_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m252_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m252_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m252_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m252_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m252_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m252_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_object_leave_normalization
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_resource_capacity
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_resource_target
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_resource_credit
						}
					var:zg361_we_m252_object_type_code = 252
					var:zg361_we_m252_consumer_contract = 252
					var:zg361_we_m252_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m252_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m252_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m252_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m252_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m252_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m252_object_case = var:zg361_we_m252_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m252_object_state = var:zg361_we_m252_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m252_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_type_code = 252
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_consumer_contract = 252
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m252_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m252_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m252_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m252_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m252_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m252_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m252_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m252_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m252_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m252_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m252_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m252_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m252_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m252_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m252_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m252_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m252_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m252_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m252_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m252_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m252_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m252_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m252_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_normalize_leave_252 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m252_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m252_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_consumer_normalize_leave_252 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #252 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.
zg361_we_m252_route_a_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	remove_variable = zg361_we_last_red_code

	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_choice

						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 6
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 6
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 6
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_total
					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
					has_variable = zg361_we_hours_available
				}
				var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
				var:zg361_we_hours_available >= 8
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ab_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ab_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ab_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ab_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ab_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ab_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m252_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = 6
			OPERATION_ID = 252
			CHOICE = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_normalize_leave_252 value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_we_operation_used add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_choice value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_type_code value = 252 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_leave_normalization value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_state value = 6 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 add = 252 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m252_consumer_contract value = 252 }

# #253 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m253_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m253_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m253_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m253_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 253 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_recovery_response_253
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m253_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ab_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ab_owner
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ab_subject
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ab_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_case = var:zg361_case_ab_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m253_write_state = var:zg361_case_ab_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m253_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_recovery_plan
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_resource_pip
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_resource_appeal
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_resource_manager_score
						}
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_type_code = 253
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumer_contract = 253
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_case = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m253_object_state = var:zg361_we_m253_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m253_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_type_code = 253
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_consumer_contract = 253
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m253_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m253_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m253_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m253_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m253_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m253_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_recovery_response_253 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m253_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m253_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_consumer_record_recovery_response_253 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m253_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ab_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}
